title: Buxar & the Diwani: Plassey detail, Nawabs' terms

boxes.title: Plassey: the battle
items: Siraj had **French** support; fled, was captured, executed
Before it: Siraj took **Qasim Bazar** → Calcutta; Treaty of **Alinagar** (Feb 1757)

boxes.title: Plassey: who stood where
head: Side
Persons
rows: **Mir Jafar** (==Mir Bakshi==), **Rai Durlabh**, Jagat Seth, **Amir Chand** (Omichund), **Manik Chand**

boxes.title: Nawabs: added terms
head: Nawab
Added detail
rows: Pension **Rs 15,000** a month (⚠ other notes: Rs 1,500 annually); after Bidara ==Dutch left India==
Accepted limits on **army size**; died soon after Buxar
Half of **Sylhet** chunam trade; ==**Rs 5 lakh**== for southern wars
Modernised army; finances improved; Indian merchants paid same as English

boxes.title: More points
items: ⚠ Rs 53 lakh: some notes say the ==Company received it==
